links.outcome: Completion of confirmatory examination among AI-positive patients
links.effect: Of 76 AI-positive patients, 34 (44.7%) completed confirmatory examination at the institution's retina clinic; externally completed follow-up was not captured.
links.quote: Seventy-six (29.6%) patients screened positive for mtmDR, of whom 34 (44.7%) completed confirmatory examination at the institution's retina clinic; externally completed follow-up was not captured.

unlisted_practices: Point-of-care autonomous AI screening in endocrinology clinic with non-ophthalmic operator

screen.reason: Prospective real-world clinical integration and workflow evaluation of an autonomous AI system for diabetic retinopathy screening in an endocrinology clinic, assessing feasibility and downstream referral outcomes without testing a comparative deployment practice.
